title: Isolate Paper order lifecycle from position-mark refresh
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Run Paper open-order lifecycle processing independently from Paper position mark refresh so a slow or blocked mark-refresh pass cannot delay Maker-GTD expiry or any other open-order lifecycle action.
inScope: Keep PaperTradingWorker as the dedicated open-order lifecycle worker using the existing PaperTrading:OpenOrderProcessingIntervalSeconds cadence.
Remove position mark refresh from IPaperTradingProcessor.ProcessOpenOrdersAsync while preserving every existing open-order priority, fill, expiry, persistence, and error path.
Expose the existing position-mark refresh operation through a separate IPaperPositionMarkProcessor contract implemented by the same stateless PaperTradingProcessor singleton.

Add a separately registered PaperPositionMarkWorker that awaits one complete mark-refresh pass before its next delay and uses the existing PaperTrading:OpenOrderProcessingIntervalSeconds cadence without adding configuration.
Preserve the existing position mark calculation, fresh WebSocket cache preference, REST fallback, optimistic concurrency update, exposure-cache update, and per-position error handling.
Add deterministic tests proving that a blocked mark refresh does not block an expired exact-family Maker-GTD lifecycle pass and that mark refresh continues through the separate worker path.
Update the current README Paper worker description to state the independent lifecycle and mark-refresh loops.
Build, focused-test, mechanically validate, independently review, commit, and push the local correction.
outOfScope: Changing any strategy signal, threshold, selected outcome, lookback window, entry timing, order price, stake, risk gate, Maker-GTD TouchNoDepth evidence, fill model, GTD/PostOnly behavior, Paper PnL, fee formula, settlement formula, or Live execution.
Adding a position-mark batch-size or time-budget policy, changing mark calculations, deduplicating positions by asset, changing cache freshness rules, or adding a new configuration option.
Changing database schema, repository queries, persisted records, Dashboard projections, external APIs, or market-data subscriptions.
Expiring, filling, settling, replaying, or rewriting production records directly; restarting, deploying, or reconfiguring the service.
Modifying, staging, committing, or incorporating the unrelated dirty Historical Gross/Net and Progress-strategy worktree changes.
scope.periodOrFilter: All Paper open orders handled by PaperTradingProcessor, with the observed production incident specifically covering 13 expired exact ETH Reference Average Maker-GTD group-8223 Pending/Resting orders at the final 2026-08-20T06:58:52.521591Z read-only snapshot. No production row is a mutation target.
scope.firstVerification: Trace the deployed ca24eff3 PaperTradingWorker, PaperTradingProcessor, DI registration, position-mark loop, and focused tests; independently verify from production read-only evidence that open-order lifecycle was delayed while core betting remained active.

requirements.text: Paper open-order lifecycle processing must run independently from Paper position mark refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: IPaperTradingProcessor.ProcessOpenOrdersAsync performs no whole-portfolio position-mark refresh before returning, including when there are zero open orders.
PaperTradingWorker continues awaiting only the open-order lifecycle operation and then its existing configured delay; it does not await the separate mark-refresh worker.
A separately hosted PaperPositionMarkWorker invokes IPaperPositionMarkProcessor.RefreshPositionMarksAsync and cannot run overlapping refresh passes within its own loop.
Both workers use the existing positive PaperTrading:OpenOrderProcessingIntervalSeconds value; no new cadence, batch, timeout, or configuration default is introduced.

When a mark-refresh call is deliberately blocked in a test, an independently started PaperTradingWorker still executes its open-order cycle and an expired valid Maker-GTD order reaches the existing terminal expiry path.
The service registers exactly one PaperTradingProcessor singleton and maps both processor interfaces to that same instance, then hosts both workers independently.

requirements.text: The isolation must preserve existing Paper order, mark, accounting, and safety semantics while changing only scheduling ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: Open-order priority remains expired first, then initial-executable opening-limit orders, then earliest expiry; the configured fill-simulation batch cap remains unchanged.

Exact Maker-GTD expiry continues using the existing atomic evidence/mutation path, mandatory label, PaperOnly boundary, and Live-disabled closed exception without changing fill or expiry classification.

RefreshPositionMarksAsync uses the same snapshot positions and unchanged estimated value, Gross unrealized PnL, Net unrealized PnL, WebSocket-cache-first/REST-fallback lookup, optimistic repository update, exposure-cache update, and per-position error persistence logic.
Concurrent settlement or fill cannot be overwritten by a stale mark update; existing optimistic-concurrency regressions remain passing through the new mark-refresh entry point.
No product database, service, strategy, order, position, settlement, configuration, deployment, restart, or external venue state is changed by Codex in this task.
README describes two independent workers without claiming that position marks have a new freshness guarantee or batch bound.
